headline: Higher sales and operating profit, lower net profit
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 5.75T, up 30.2% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 899.2B, up 61.3% y/y, while net income fell 17.8% to KRW 354.3B.
summary_long: Net income was KRW 822.1B in the prior quarter, so the quarter-over-quarter decline was larger than the y/y one. Another source puts standalone revenue at KRW 5.73T and operating profit at KRW 891.7B. Yahoo EPS was KRW 3,376. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of provisional results; net income is the Yahoo shard value. Shard operating income (KRW 1,170.6B) does not match reported figures and is not used. Group-level figures for the wider HD Hyundai were excluded.
